body.name: Assignment-preserving hard subexperiment
body.construction: Draw \(Z\) independently of coefficients. Under \(P_{0,a}\), draw \(\beta_{ka,1}\) independently with density \(h_0\) and set \(\beta_{ka,2}=\beta_{ka,3}=0\). Under \(P_{1,a}\), use the same baseline law, set \(\beta_{ka,2}=0\), and draw \(\beta_{ka,3}=aS_{ka}\) with independent Rademacher signs \(S_{ka}\). Observe \((Z,Y^{\mathrm{obs}})\); every alternative draw has \(g_r(\beta)=a^2\), hence belongs to \(\mathcal B_{1,r}(H,a^2)\).
